title: Effect streamText runs tool handlers eagerly with interruption
claim: Effect #7486 (merged 2026-08-27T02:19Z): one rule for generateText and streamText — a tool handler runs only after the response is known to have moved past that tool call. streamText uses one-chunk lookahead so an incomplete finish cannot start handlers. Alternative to #7447 that keeps safety without giving up eager streaming execution. Directly relevant to beep AI toolkit / yeet tool loops.
excerpt: One rule for both paths: a tool call executes only when the response is known to have moved past it. streamText uses a one-chunk lookahead: a handler starts once the stream advances past its tool call (the next chunk arrives, or the stream ends with a complete finish).
